name: peace-meal-audit
description: Audit tooling for Peace Meal. The app itself has no dependencies; this folder does.

scripts.e2e: cd .. && node audit/e2e/journeys.mjs; node audit/e2e/data-safety.mjs; node audit/e2e/offline-iphone.mjs; node audit/e2e/xss.mjs; node audit/e2e/screenshots.mjs
scripts.privacy: cd .. && node audit/e2e/network.mjs; node audit/scripts/sri-check.mjs; node audit/e2e/csp.mjs; node audit/e2e/shared-origin.mjs; node audit/e2e/old-address.mjs; node audit/scripts/live-stamp.mjs
scripts.data: cd .. && node audit/scripts/data-quality.mjs; node audit/scripts/rule-mutations.mjs; node audit/scripts/readability.mjs
scripts.mutation: cd .. && audit/node_modules/.bin/stryker run audit/stryker.conf.json && node audit/scripts/stryker-summary.mjs
